questions.text: Describe a game you enjoyed playing.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a game you enjoyed playing. You should say: what the game was; who you played it with; how you played it; and explain why you enjoyed playing this game.

questions.text: Do you still play this game?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you still play this game?

questions.text: What kinds of games are popular with families in your country?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a game you enjoyed playing, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all games. What kinds of games are popular with families in your country?

questions.text: What can children learn from playing games with other people?
